The Mushaf

Read by page and surah

  • The Madinah Mushaf

    Page by page and line by line, as printed by the King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex.

  • Three reading modes

    Mushaf view, Reading view and Focus view.

  • Focus mode

    For reading and memorization, with a self-test for revision.

  • Index and search

    A surah and juz index, and fast word search that ignores diacritics.

  • Verified text

    All 6,236 ayahs are verified before every release.

  • Works offline

    The mushaf opens instantly with no internet.

  • Mushaf font and size

    Choose your Uthmani script font, and enlarge or reduce the text.

Tafsir

Nine classical Arabic tafsirs

  • The tafsirs

    al-Muyassar, Ibn Kathir, al-Tabari, al-Qurtubi, al-Baghawi, al-Sa'di, al-Jalalayn, al-Wasit and Ibn Ashur's al-Tahrir wa al-Tanwir.

  • As their authors wrote them

    Credited, never shortened or rewritten.

  • Offline

    Download the ones you want and read them offline.

Listening

17 renowned reciters

  • Reciters

    Including Mahmoud Khalil al-Husary, Muhammad Siddiq al-Minshawi, Abdul Basit Abdul Samad, Mishary Alafasy, Maher al-Muaiqly, Abdul Rahman al-Sudais, Saud al-Shuraim, Saad al-Ghamdi and Yasser al-Dosari.

  • Follow the word

    The recited word is highlighted on the page with reciters whose timings are available.

  • For memorizing and sleep

    Ayah repeat for memorization, and a sleep timer.

  • In the background

    Playback in the background and from the lock screen.

  • Offline

    Download surahs and listen offline.

  • Speed and ayah range

    Change the playback speed, and choose a range of ayahs to repeat.

Prayer and Qibla

Times for your location, calculated on your device

  • Prayer times

    Using the Umm al-Qura method. Your location is never sent to a server.

  • Notifications

    Prayer time notifications, a choice of adhan sound and an iqamah alert.

  • Qibla

    A Qibla compass, or choose your city by hand.

Azkar and Misbaha

From Hisn al-Muslim

  • Daily Azkar

    Morning, evening and by occasion.

  • Counter and done mark

    A counter for every dhikr with a set number, and a done mark for each.

  • Favourites and reminders

    Save the ones you love and get reminders at their times.

  • Listening

    A player for recited Azkar, with downloads for offline listening.

  • Misbaha

    A digital misbaha with a target of 33, 99, 100 or your own, on the phone, the watch and a widget.

  • Search and share

    Search the Azkar and share the ones you love.

Hijri calendar and moon

Calculated on your device, no internet needed

  • Hijri calendar

    The Umm al-Qura calendar with occasions. It may differ by a day from your country's announcement, and you can adjust it.

  • Moon sighting

    Moon age at sunset and illumination for your location. A calculation, not a replacement for the official announcement.

Your daily wird

Your Khatma, goals and marks

  • Khatma plan

    Divides the Quran over the days you choose.

  • Daily goals

    For your wird, Azkar and tasbih, with progress tracking.

  • My Mushaf

    Bookmarks, highlights and notes on ayahs.

  • Reminders

    For prayer, Azkar, wird, the misbaha and Surat al-Kahf on Friday.

Widgets and Apple Watch

Taybah on your Home Screen and your wrist

  • Widgets

    Next prayer, today's times, today's progress, continue reading, misbaha and Azkar. Never Quran or dhikr text.

  • Apple Watch

    Next prayer, today's times, the misbaha and Azkar status.

The app

Crafted with care

  • Arabic first

    With a complete English interface.

  • Appearance

    Light, sepia and dark, with an automatic switch to dark after Maghrib.

  • Discover Taybah

    A guided tour of the features, step by step.

  • Downloads and storage

    Control what you download and its size, with a Wi-Fi-only option.

  • Accessibility

    Supports VoiceOver, TalkBack, larger text and Reduce Motion.

Free. No ads. No account.
